assessment_and_recommendation.rationale: At B=100, Mode A peak VRAM is only 459.8 MB (< 4% of 12GB GPU), leaving over 11.5 GB of headroom. Since VRAM is not constrained, retaining the full continuous autograd graph avoids truncating physical parameter gradients during warmup spin-up.

mode_a_continuous_730d_graph.description: Full 730-day forward retains computation graph; loss computed on scored days [365:730]; gradient flows through physical state transitions across warmup.
mode_a_continuous_730d_graph.gradient_semantic_soundness: Strictly continuous physical BPTT across full window

mode_b_warmup_detached_graph.description: First 365 days executed under torch.no_grad(); only scored days [365:730] build autograd graph.
mode_b_warmup_detached_graph.gradient_semantic_soundness: Truncates gradient flow through warmup state initialization
